app.name: ArkMCL
cli.help:
Usage: arkmcl [OPTIONS] Commands: account Manage accounts (default: --list) completion Print shell completion scripts help Print this help info Print runtime information as JSON instance Manage instances (default: instance info) launch Manage runs (lists running instances without an instance) resource Browse, search, and download resources (lists local resources when used alone) service Service status and stop version Print version account: [...] Select accounts (wildcards allowed); lists matches when no action is given --add Add an account: no name = Microsoft device code; name = offline; with --server = external login --default Print the default account without a selector; set it with a selector (only one) --info Print account information; uses the default account when no selector is given --list List accounts grouped by type --refresh Refresh tokens; refreshes all Microsoft accounts when no selector is given; cannot be combined with --add, --remove, or --default --remove Remove accounts (batch requires confirmation) --server External login server (used with --add) instance: [...] Select instances (wildcards allowed); prints instance info when no action is given; prints global defaults without an instance; with --create, use as the instance id Options marked [global] read or write the global defaults without a selector; with a selector and no value, they query that instance. --account Set or query the instance account --create Create an instance (the name defaults to the id when one is given; without an id, --name and --version are required) --create-defaults [] Whether to copy default config files (default: true); create and global only [global] --default Print the default instance without a selector; set it with a selector (only one) --group [] Set or query the group; lists groups when used alone without a selector [global] --group-move Move every instance in a group to another group (mv-like) --import Import a local or HTTPS .mrpack --info Print instance information; uses the default instance when no selector is given --java [] Java: default = version suggestion; number = major version; path = JDK home (like JAVA_HOME); with a selector, print the Java in use [global] --jvm-args [] Set or query JVM arguments; default = Aikar flags, none = clear [global] --link [] Query or update shared links: all|none|name list [global] --list List instances by group --loader [] Set or query the loader: fabric|forge|neoforge|purpur|none [global] --loader-version Set or query the loader version --lwjgl Override the LWJGL version (default restores it) --memory [] Set or query the memory limit; client >=512, server >=256 [global] --move Change the instance id (directory name) --name [] Set or query the name (requires one instance) --remove Move instances to the system trash (batch requires confirmation) --type [] Set or query the instance type: client|server; immutable after create [global] --version [] Set or query the Minecraft version [global] launch: [...] Select instances (wildcards allowed); attaches the console when no action is given; lists running instances without an instance --list List running instances --prepare Validate and fill in missing resources --prepare-download-threads Download threads (default: 8, range 1-64) --start Start an instance and attach the console --stop Force-terminate instances (batch requires confirmation; use --terminal and send stop for a graceful shutdown) --terminal Attach the console; input goes to the process, ^X detaches, ^L clears resource: --api

Resource provider: modrinth|curseforge (search, lookup, and download) --autoremove List global resources not referenced by any instance; add --yes to move them to the trash --download ... Download resources; use --download-version to pick versions --download- Download by type: mod, modpack, resourcepack, shader, datapack, world, plugin; non-modpacks require --download-to-instance --download-to-instance Download into an instance (modpacks are global only) --download-version Version to download; the count must match --download --filter-loader <...> Loader filter, repeatable --filter-vanilla <...> Version type: all|stable|snapshot|foolsday|legacy, repeatable --filter-version <...> Game version pattern, repeatable --list List local resources --list-limit Limit output rows (1-100) --list-remote List Minecraft versions; with --filter-loader, list loader versions --lookup Show project versions --search Search community resources (requires --type) --type worlds|resourcepacks|datapacks|shaderpacks|mods|plugins|modpacks service: status Show service status (does not start the service) stop Stop the service (does not start the service) Options: -h, --help Print this help --json Print machine-readable JSON --lang Language: zh-CN or en-US --list-sort List order, default asc --list-sort-by Sort keys, by command: create|launch|run|alphabet|download|name|relevance -V, --version Print version --yes Skip batch confirmations
cli.error.protocol: Service protocol {server} is incompatible with client protocol {client}; update arkmcl-service or arkmcl.

  --server <url>     Add an external account
  --uuid <uuid>      Optional UUID for an external account
